description: GraphQL Dashboard Integration — the Active Dashboard's stop/pause/resume controls use GraphQL mutations. The orchestration loop banner uses a GraphQL subscription for phase detection. The connection health badge uses a health subscription. Dashboard data refreshes are triggered by subscription events rather than blind polling.
preconditions: At least one task run exists (running preferred for full coverage)

groups.name: Mutation-Backed Lifecycle Controls
groups.description: The dashboard control bar's stop, pause, and resume actions use GraphQL mutations. The mutation result automatically updates the cache.

assertions.description: The Stop button terminates the running workflow. Status transitions to 'stopped'.
assertions.expected: Task status changes to 'stopped' within 2 seconds

assertions.description: Pause suspends the workflow. Resume continues it. The control bar updates to reflect the current state.

groups.name: Subscription-Driven Updates
groups.description: Dashboard data refreshes when events arrive via subscription, not on a fixed polling interval.

assertions.description: Task status changes (completion, failure, stop) are reflected in the dashboard within 2 seconds
After stopping a task, all dashboard widgets show consistent 'stopped' state — no widget shows stale 'running'

groups.name: Orchestration Loop Banner
groups.description: A banner appears at the top of the dashboard when an orchestration loop is running. Shows phase, iteration progress, and control buttons. Phase updates are driven by a GraphQL subscription.
groups.precondition: An orchestration loop is running (workflow with max_iterations > 1)

assertions.description: The banner shows the current phase name: Building, Executing, Reflecting, Fixing, Evaluating, Complete, or Stopped
The banner does not appear when no orchestration loop is running

groups.name: Connection Health Badge
groups.description: The bottom bar shows a connection status indicator powered by a GraphQL health subscription. Falls back to REST polling if the subscription is unavailable.

assertions.description: A connection status indicator is visible in the bottom bar
